# gpupaas_bare_metal_sku (Data Source)

A bare-metal SKU (BmProfile): the images, datacenters and options a `gpupaas_bare_metal_instance` created from it may use.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpupaas_bare_metal_sku" "gpu" {
  project = "system-catalog"
  name    = "bmaas-l40s"
}

output "images" {
  value = data.gpupaas_bare_metal_sku.gpu.images
}

output "datacenters" {
  value = data.gpupaas_bare_metal_sku.gpu.datacenters
}

output "public_ip_policy" {
  value = data.gpupaas_bare_metal_sku.gpu.assign_public_ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project` (String) Project that holds the SKU, usually `system-catalog`.

### Read-Only

- `agents` (List of String) Orchestration agents that run the SKU's workflows. Provisioning fails with "no healthy agents found" when none of them is healthy; the list is not a health check.
- `assign_public_ip` (String) Public IP policy: `Disabled`, `Enabled` or `CustomerSelectable`.
- `contract_terms` (List of Number) Contract terms in months the SKU offers.
- `datacenters` (List of String) Datacenters machines of this SKU may be placed in.
- `default_image` (String)
- `gpu_name` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `images` (List of String) Images machines of this SKU may use.
- `inventory_config` (Attributes List) Inventory tags: devices tagged `key=value` are candidates for machines of this SKU. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--inventory_config))
- `object_storage_enabled` (Boolean)
- `provisioner_type` (String) `bcm` or `non_bcm`.
- `shared_filesystem_enabled` (Boolean)
- `status` (String)
- `subnet` (String)
- `template_version` (String)
- `use_case` (String)
- `vpc` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--inventory_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `inventory_config`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)
